assumptions.breakdown_note: At most one breakdown per line-shift-day (Bernoulli draw), station-weighted toward the bottleneck; other reasons are line-level.
assumptions.overlap_note: Event minutes overlapping an hour cell are booked to that cell; booked unplanned minutes are capped at planned minutes and minor-stop minutes at run minutes.
assumptions.planned_maintenance_note: Planned maintenance is scheduled downtime excluded from planned production time (shift A only).
assumptions.quality_note: Scrap drawn per hour cell from a binomial with the cell defect rate; causes split the daily scrap proportionally.
